import sys, random

def run(cmds):
    slots = []  # each: {'buf': bytearray or None, 'gen': int, 'occupied': bool}
    free = []
    import heapq
    out = []
    live_count = 0
    live_bytes = 0

    def is_live(i, g):
        if i >= len(slots):
            return False
        return slots[i]['occupied'] and slots[i]['gen'] == g

    for line in cmds:
        parts = line.split()
        if not parts:
            continue
        cmd = parts[0]
        if cmd == 'new':
            s = int(parts[1])
            if free:
                slot = heapq.heappop(free)
            else:
                slot = len(slots)
                slots.append({'buf': None, 'gen': 0, 'occupied': False})
            slots[slot]['gen'] += 1
            slots[slot]['occupied'] = True
            slots[slot]['buf'] = bytearray(s)
            live_count += 1
            live_bytes += s
            out.append(f"h {slot} {slots[slot]['gen']}")
        elif cmd == 'set':
            i, g, off, v = int(parts[1]), int(parts[2]), int(parts[3]), int(parts[4])
            if not is_live(i, g):
                out.append("stale")
                continue
            if off >= len(slots[i]['buf']):
                out.append("bounds")
                continue
            slots[i]['buf'][off] = v
            out.append("ok")
        elif cmd == 'sum':
            i, g = int(parts[1]), int(parts[2])
            if not is_live(i, g):
                out.append("stale")
                continue
            out.append(str(sum(slots[i]['buf'])))
        elif cmd == 'move':
            i, g, j, h = int(parts[1]), int(parts[2]), int(parts[3]), int(parts[4])
            if not is_live(i, g) or not is_live(j, h):
                out.append("stale")
                continue
            if i == j and g == h:
                out.append("same")
                continue
            slots[j]['buf'].extend(slots[i]['buf'])
            slots[i]['occupied'] = False
            slots[i]['buf'] = None
            live_count -= 1
            heapq.heappush(free, i)
            out.append(f"ok {len(slots[j]['buf'])}")
        elif cmd == 'free':
            i, g = int(parts[1]), int(parts[2])
            if not is_live(i, g):
                out.append("stale")
                continue
            live_count -= 1
            live_bytes -= len(slots[i]['buf'])
            slots[i]['occupied'] = False
            slots[i]['buf'] = None
            heapq.heappush(free, i)
            out.append("ok")
    out.append(f"live {live_count} {live_bytes}")
    return "\n".join(out) + "\n"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    with open(sys.argv[1]) as f:
        lines = f.read().splitlines()
    sys.stdout.write(run(lines))
